subject: Minecraft Java 1.8.8 setblock-authored redstone block direct power into adjacent command blocks and diode rear inputs

observed_source_semantics.setblock_write_and_notify: CommandSetBlock writes the requested block state and then calls World.notifyNeighborsRespectDebug on the authored coordinate.
observed_source_semantics.powered_block_output: BlockCompressedPowered.canProvidePower returns true and getWeakPower returns 15 on every queried side.
observed_source_semantics.world_power_query: A power-providing redstone block is not treated as a normal cube by Block.isNormalCube; World.getRedstonePower therefore delegates to its weak-power output.
observed_source_semantics.command_block_rising_edge: BlockCommandBlock.onNeighborBlockChange calls World.isBlockPowered and schedules command execution on an untriggered powered rising edge.
observed_source_semantics.diode_rear_input: BlockRedstoneDiode.calculateInputStrength reads World.getRedstonePower at pos.offset(FACING), so only the exact decoded rear-input coordinate qualifies.

supported_relations.source: executing legacy setblock command whose compact authored state is redstone_block
supported_relations.target: legacy command_block immediately adjacent to the authored coordinate

supported_relations.source: executing legacy setblock command whose compact authored state is redstone_block
supported_relations.target: repeater/comparator whose exact decoded rear-input coordinate equals the authored coordinate

compact_state_boundary.purpose: redstone_block qualifies the power-producing write; air permits text-free recognition of the corresponding reset without creating a power edge

inference_boundary: The relation requires exact resolution of the setblock coordinate and compact redstone_block state class.
No edge is created from an air write or an unclassified authored block state.
No generic setblock-to-feedback, command-to-command, physical-adjacency, dust, opaque-solid-conduction, or quasi-connectivity relation is implied.
A direct power relation still presumes execution of the source command; static recoverability is not a runtime execution receipt.
Client delivery, perception, comprehension, legibility, and qualitative value remain separate.
